| **progressive automation** | Existed only as policy in operations | Created `work/terms/progressive-automation.md` — agent→skill→tool→hook sequence, lean/jidoka roots |
| **settlement path** | Referenced in texts but no term | Created `work/terms/settlement-path.md` — inquiry→derivation→procedure→process trajectory, Dewey grounding, closure operator connection |

All four are `readiness: draft`, cross-linked to each other and to existing terms. The three work-domain terms form a tight cluster: formality-level measures where you are, settlement-path describes the direction, progressive-automation is the policy that drives movement.
